description:
Per-mount state a DEPLOYMENT carries, as a list of ``{reference, config}`` items.

Two things live here: the PVC generation each mount points at (the shared clone state),
and this deployment's own size for that mount. A deployment that sets no ``size`` follows
the component. The verdict is not here: it is one ceiling per deployment, on the
deployment layer.

generation.description: Current generation, incremented on each clone. Written by the platform.

size.description: This deployment's own size for this volume, overriding the component's. Same range as the component (50Mi up to and including 50Gi); above the project's ceiling (at least 2Gi) this deployment needs a ceiling of its own. Absent means: follow the component.
